newsitem.title: CHINA: North China Pharmaceutical aims to list in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: North China Pharmaceutical aims to list in Tokyo.

text.p: North China Pharmaceutical (Group) Co Ltd is planning to issue two billion yuan in new shares to be listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, a company official said on Monday.
The company has not decided a timetable and pricing for the issue, he said. The listing in Tokyo depends on approval from the securities authorities of both countries, he said.
He declined to give further details.
The company is among the 38 mainland Chinese enterprises newly chosen by the Securities Commission of the State Council as candidates for listing on overseas stock markets.
A unit of the company, North China Pharmaceutical Co Ltd has domestic A shares listed in Shanghai.
